- |+ # Chomping indicator↓
 keep

- >1- # Both indicators↓
  strip

+DOC
+SEQ
=VAL |literal\n
=VAL > folded\n
=VAL |keep\n\n
=VAL > strip
-SEQ
-DOC
-STR

  "literal\n",
  " folded\n",
  "keep\n\n",
  " strip"
